name: Rounded cap crop

curly.note: cut dry and let the curls shape the cap

coily.note: keep length on top for shrinkage

high.note: thin the sides if very thick

growth.note: The crown whorl needs a longer section or it may poke up.

strand_note: Works with medium to fine strands; coarse strands are bulkier.
grow_out: As it grows the cap fills in at the nape and turns into a bixie, with no awkward stage.
client: A neat, soft, rounded short cut that frames the face and stays tidy.
stylist: Create a uniform curved shape from crown to ears using over-direction, then blend the nape with a short taper. Soften the perimeter by point cutting. Weight: round weight sits above the ears.
prompt_spec: a rounded cap crop: a neat curved shape with the top 6-9 cm, a curtain fringe of 4-7 cm at the brow, the sides 3-6 cm with round weight above the ears and the nape 2-5 cm tapered short, soft point-cut edges

name: Tapered curly crop with longer top
aliases: curly fade with length on top

wavy.note: loose waves need more length on top

growth.note: The taper follows the nape and ear shape; a nape whorl may need a longer guard.

strand_note: Works with all curl diameters; tight coils give height and loose curls give drape.
grow_out: The sides fill in and the cut grows into a curly bixie.
client: A cut with long curls on top and tight sides.
stylist: Taper the sides and nape with clippers and keep the top 8-14 cm stretched so curls fall in their natural pattern. Weight: longer curls on top, tapered tight at the sides and nape.
prompt_spec: a tapered curly crop: long defined curls on top of 8-14 cm falling in their natural pattern with a side-swept curly fringe of 6-12 cm at the brow, the sides and nape tapered tight to 0.5-3 cm

name: Curly bowl crop

wavy.note: waves need more length to form the cap

low.note: fine curls make a lighter cap, so avoid thinning

growth.note: The crown whorl affects the cap, so keep the length longer there.

strand_note: The cap needs enough curl density to hold a round outline.
grow_out: The cap grows into a curly bob as the sides lengthen, and only the fringe needs trimming in between.
client: A round, short cap of curls with a short fringe.
stylist: Cut dry in a circle from the crown, keeping the perimeter even and adding a short fringe. Weight: a rounded cap of curls, with weight sitting around the ears.
prompt_spec: a curly bowl crop: a round cap of defined curls with the top 7-12 cm, weight sitting around the ears, the sides and back 3-6 cm, and a short curly fringe of 4-8 cm at the brow, an even rounded perimeter

name: Eton crop

wavy.note: waves need gel to lie flat

high.note: thick hair stands off the head and needs closer tapering

growth.note: A crown whorl or a cowlick makes slicking back difficult.

strand_note: Fine to medium straight strands lie flat and give the sleek finish.
grow_out: Grows out through a micro pixie stage and then a pixie, so expect about 8 weeks before it can be styled again.
client: A very short, sleek crop that hugs the head and shows off the face. Classic and graphic.
stylist: Clipper-cut the sides and nape tight, scissor the top to 2-5 cm and comb back to set the shape. Weight: smooth, close to the head; no volume anywhere.
prompt_spec: an Eton crop: a very short sleek crop that hugs the head, the top 2-5 cm combed back with no fringe, the sides 1-3 cm and the nape 0.5-2 cm clipped tight above the ears, smooth with no volume, the face fully visible

name: French crop

fade.note: Low taper, #3 down to #1, kept simple so the fringe is the focus.

wavy.note: Lift texture with clay and keep the top at 3-4 cm.

curly.note: Use a blunt-cut fringe at the shorter end to avoid hanging forward.

coily.note: Shorten fringe to 2 cm and shape-up the line.

low.note: Keep the fringe short and textured; a heavy fringe looks sparse.

growth.whorl_note: Crown whorls are hidden; cowlicks at the hairline may need blow-dry.
growth.note: One of the strongest options for a hairline that is higher at the temples or high overall, because the fringe covers it.

density_note: Medium to thick; needs enough density to hold a visible fringe.
glasses_note: The fringe should clear the top of the frames by 1 cm.
grow_out: Becomes a longer fringe crop at 8 weeks; keep fringe trimmed.
client: Short sides with a short, straight fringe brushed forward. Neat and very easy to live with.
stylist: Cut the fringe straight with scissors, then point-cut to break it. Back and sides tapered, no dramatic fade. Tapered or rounded.
prompt_spec: a French crop: the top 2.5-5 cm cut short, with a short straight fringe of 1.5-3 cm pushed forward above the brow, the sides and back at a low taper from #3 (10 mm) to #1 (3 mm), a tapered neckline, no part, a neat sharp finish

name: Caesar cut

fade.note: Light taper; the line from fringe to sides is short and clean.

curly.note: Use shorter fringe to prevent curls hanging in the eyes.

coily.note: Short, flat or waved top with line-up works well.

low.note: Keep the fringe short and choppy so less scalp shows.

growth.note: Very good for stage 3-5; the straight horizontal fringe conceals a hairline that is higher at the temples.

density_note: Needs medium to high density on top.
grow_out: Grows into a French crop and then a longer textured fringe.
client: A short, even top combed forward with a straight fringe. Neat, tidy and quick to style.
stylist: Scissor-over-comb top to an even 2-3 cm, fringe cut straight just above the brow. Add light texturising if too heavy. Natural or lightly rounded.
prompt_spec: a Caesar cut: an even top of 2-3.5 cm combed forward, with a short straight fringe of 1.5-3 cm just above the brow, the sides and back tapered lightly from #3 (9 mm) to #1 (3 mm), a clean short line from fringe to sides, a natural neckline

name: Textured crop with low taper

fade.note: Low taper, #1 to #3; keeps weight above the ear.

wavy.note: Texture builds itself; use less product.

curly.note: Ask for a point-cut finish; leave 1 cm extra on top.

coily.note: Shape-up the fringe line; works as a defined twist or sponge top.

low.note: Use sea-salt spray and matte clay for grip and body.

growth.note: Good: fringe covers temples; at stage 4 keep fringe at the longest end.

density_note: Medium to thick; fine hair benefits from salt spray and a matte clay.
glasses_note: Fringe should clear the frame top.
grow_out: Moves toward a textured quiff or flow in 8 weeks.
client: Short sides with a choppy, messy top pushed forward. Looks styled even when you don't try.
stylist: Clipper sides, scissor top with point cutting and razor texturising; leave the longest piece at the front. Blend with scissor-over-comb at the crown.
prompt_spec: a textured crop with a low taper: a choppy top of 3-6 cm pushed forward with a fringe of 2-4 cm, the longest piece at the front, the sides and back at a low taper from #4 (13 mm) down to #1 (3 mm), weight kept above the ear, a tapered neckline

name: Textured crop with mid fade

fade.note: Skin or #0.5 to #2 blend starting at the temple height.

curly.note: Leave 1 cm extra on top to account for spring-up.

coily.note: Cut as a taper with a defined top; use curl cream.

low.note: Ask for a taper instead of skin so the top does not look sparse against the sides.

growth.note: Fringe covers temples at stage 3-4; mid fade keeps the sides neat.

density_note: Medium to thick; thinning fine hair would show contrast.
glasses_note: Tight sides around the arms; leave 2-3 mm if frames are thick.
grow_out: Fade grows out to a taper by week 4.
client: A textured top that falls forward over sides faded from mid height. Modern and quick to style.
stylist: Clip fade to skin or #0.5, then blend to #2. Scissor top and razor-texturise. Leave a short fringe with a lived-in line. Clean taper into the neckline.
prompt_spec: a textured crop with a mid fade: a choppy top of 4-7 cm falling forward into a short fringe of 3-5 cm, the sides and back faded from skin (#0.5) to #2 (6 mm), the fade line starting at temple height, a clean tapered neckline, matte texture

name: Top heavy fade

fade.note: High skin fade with the top left long and disconnected.

curly.note: Excellent; the curl length is the feature.

coily.note: Works with a defined sponge or twist top.

low.note: Keep the fade lower and the top textured; the volume on top is limited.

growth.whorl_note: Long top covers a thin crown moderately.
growth.note: High fade exposes the temples; not advised past stage 3.

density_note: Medium to thick; needs enough hair to show volume.
glasses_note: Tight fade opens the sides; frames show prominently.
grow_out: Fade grows out to a taper in 3-4 weeks; keep top trimmed.
client: Sharp, tight sides with a lot of volume on top. A strong, modern look.
stylist: Fade to skin, work from high to mid, preserve at least 6 cm on top. Blend the line cleanly by shaping the parietal ridge. Clean fade into the neck.
prompt_spec: a top-heavy fade: a long, voluminous top of 6-10 cm with the front at 4-8 cm, disconnected from sides and back faded from skin to #2 (6 mm), a high skin fade line at the temple, a clean fade into the neckline, a textured finish

name: Men's soft perm

fade.note: Scissor-tapered sides under a permed top.

curly.note: Your curls already give this shape; ask for the cut without the perm.

high.note: Remove bulk before the perm so the top does not turn wide.

growth.note: Curls add volume and cover recession.

density_note: Any density; fine hair gets more body.
glasses_note: Curls may sit on the frame arms; trim the sides shorter.
grow_out: Perm grows out over 4-6 months; cut the permed ends gradually.
client: A soft permanent wave added to straight hair for body and curl. It grows out gradually.
stylist: Use large rods on top, test a strand, and cut after the perm is set. Aftercare cream helps curl hold.
prompt_spec: a men's soft perm: a top of 6-12 cm with a fringe of 5-10 cm set in soft, loose, large-rod curls on otherwise straight hair, the sides and back scissor-tapered to 2-4 cm, the nape 1-2 cm, a tapered neckline

name: Even-length short top (crown cover)

curly.note: Keep the top 3-4 cm so curls lie flat over the crown.

coily.note: Keep the top 2-3 cm with a tidy taper.

high.note: Thin the top with scissors so it lies flat and sweeps.

growth.whorl_note: Keep the crown length the same as the rest of the top.
growth.note: Even top length leaves less contrast between thin and dense areas.

density_note: Thin or thinning hair, mostly at the crown.
glasses_note: Sits well with most frames; keep hair above the ear short so the arms rest cleanly.
grow_out: Grow the top for 8 weeks; the cut becomes a crew or Ivy base.
client: A short, even top with a slight side sweep. Tidy and unfussy, and it suits thinning at the crown.
stylist: Keep one even length over the crown and top, clipper-taper the sides and avoid long sections that would highlight thinning.
prompt_spec: a short even-length top: one even length of 2-3.5 cm over the crown and top with a slight side sweep, the sides and back clipper-tapered from #3 (9 mm) down to #1 (3 mm), the nape #1-#2, a tapered neckline

name: Curly forward crop

fade.note: Low taper under a forward-brushed curl fringe.

straight.note: Straight hair lacks the spring; use a French crop instead.

wavy.note: Needs a diffuser to keep wave curl.

coily.note: Short coils: shorten fringe to 3 cm and keep it moisturised.

low.note: Keep the curls shorter so they hold their spring.

growth.note: Forward curls cover temples and a high forehead well; one of the best for stage 3-5.

density_note: Medium to thick; fine curls collapse.
glasses_note: Keep the fringe clear of the top rim.
grow_out: Fringe lengthens to a curly flow.
client: Short sides with a curly fringe falling forward. Neat, relaxed and easy to style with cream.
stylist: Cut dry; shorten the fringe by 1 cm as curls spring up. Do not square the fringe; use a gently rounded edge.
